content.short: a16z crypto is a venture capital firm that invests in seed to late-stage technology companies.
content.description: Andreessen Horowitz, commonly known as a16z, is a venture capital firm backing bold entrepreneurs building the future through technology. Founded in Silicon Valley in 2009 by Marc Andreessen and Ben Horowitz, the firm invests from seed to late-stage in technology companies across bio and healthcare, consumer, crypto, enterprise, fintech, games, and firms pursuing American dynamism. a16z manages about $35 billion in assets across multiple funds.

resources.title: What Is a DUNA? A Legal Entity for Decentralized Orgs
resources.tldr: The corporation was the last great answer to getting people with different incentives to cooperate. Argues the DUNA is the equivalent structure for networks nobody owns, and explains what it actually is.

resources.title: Can AI Agents Actually Pull Off DeFi Exploits?
resources.tldr: Agents are demonstrably good at spotting vulnerabilities; this benchmarks whether they can write working exploits too, using real onchain price-manipulation attacks as the test cases.

resources.title: How Stablecoins Become Money: Liquidity, Sovereignty, and Credit
resources.tldr: Being fast, cheap and programmable is not the same as being money. Works through the liquidity, sovereignty and credit questions a self-custodial bearer asset raises once it carries real volume.
